newsitem.title: USA: Environmental Power cites outage costs.
newsitem.headline: Environmental Power cites outage costs.

text.p: Environmental Power Corp said its results from operations and cash flow from its Scrubgrass plant may be materially impacted for the remainder of 1997 because a longer-than-anticipated annual maintenance outage is likely to be required at the plant.
The potentially longer maintenance outage is due to the need to rewind the facility's generator, the company said.
Environmental Power, which said its budgeted annual plant outage for 1997 was about three weeks, did not provide financial details of the potential impact.
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment.
